bottomReferenceReservation.foreignCopperExclusion: Reserve this L-shaped bottom region from non-GND routing; its projection covers both complete inner2 USB traces. Do not let ordinary bottom control trunks cut the return region.
bottomReferenceReservation.stackup: L3 inner2 is adjacent to L4 bottom over proposed 0.12 mm dielectric; use this actual continuous GND reference region rather than relying only on L2 through 1.2 mm core.
bottomReferenceReservation.physicalAcceptance: Actual bottom BREP copper, after clearances/drill holes, must cover the complete projection of both inner2 USB centerlines except transition antipads; every surviving reference region must connect through plated GND stitches to the single main inner1 GND component. The physical audit checks connectivity; explicitly check swept USB projection vs bottom BREP for uninterrupted coverage.
bottomReferenceReservation.scope: Bottom trace-only exclusion; foreign through vias allowed with antipads if actual earlier USB trace copper/drills clear.

lengthConstraintScope.finding: A power-to-GND capacitor automatically assigns 1 mm to every attached trace, including supply distribution. Schmitt middle VCC pin pad height 1.1 mm plus capacitor pad height 0.8 mm and 0.2 mm solder-pad clearance require at least 1.15 mm pad-center separation. 1.25 mm center paths contain only 0.3 mm exposed inter-pad copper.
lengthConstraintScope.requiredParentAction: Render dedicated cap-to-true-VCC traces with pcbStraightLine and no pcbPath; core clips trace endpoints at pad edges and preserves source-port connectivity. Keep maxLength=1 for these actual bypasses. Give supply distribution and latch static-input tie traces explicit realistic maxLength budgets; props.maxLength overrides automatic capacitor inheritance. True latch supply is pin8; pin2 is D tied high, and pin7 is preset tied high.

notes: Keep source nets and functional interlock logic unchanged.
These routing-only placements require regenerating global ports.json and ripping up stale copper.
Supply tree latch pin2/pin7/pin8 necks must be 0.2 mm; 0.4 mm cannot escape adjacent 0.3 mm pads on 0.5 mm pitch.
No IC signal pad is used as a routing transit node.
Inner1 remains GND. Through vias 0.7/0.3 mm and trace/pad clearance 0.2 mm are conservatively enforced for this scoped geometry.
Apply C_AUX1/C_AUX2/Q_AUX_FAULT poses in input-loss-interlock.tsx: these added parts have explicit coordinates and do not use clearancePlacements.
All physicalTraces have explicit maxLength: dedicated capacitor bypasses/ground returns retain 1 mm; distribution and signal paths use measured geometry plus margin.
External MCU/thermal placements are dependency records. Merge those owners latest artifacts and regenerate all geometry after final placement before shared-board installation.
